Gleaming steel human-sized droid with a single red eye. Bristling with weapons.

AC 15, HP 34, ATK 2 slam +8 (2d8) or 1 laser rifle (far) +8 (3d6) or 1 rocket, MV near (fly), S +4, D +1, C +3, I +1, W +0, Ch -3, AL N, LV 7

Delicate Machinery. Critical hits against robot do an extra die of damage. Takes double damage from lightning.

Force Field. Has 10 HP. Unless reduced to 0 HP, regains 2d6 HP a turn. Once reduced to 0 HP or if dispel magic is cast on robot, dormant for 24 hours.

Rocket. Launch a rocket within distant. All creatures in a near-sized cube around where the blast lands, DEX 12+ or 3d6 damage. Cannot use again for 1d4 rounds.

Superior Optics. Can see all invisible creatures and objects.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
